video_title: This Rematch Got Personal at Bandon Trails (2v2 Shamble)

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James calls Bandon Trails golf porn for enthusiasts

quotes.quote: I was in the car when we were leaving the range. I said for golf enthusiasts, this is golf porn for sure. There is no question about it. Like, this is exactly where they want to be, hope to be at some point. Super honored and blessed to be here.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James proposes a new rule for their golf matches
quotes.excerpt: Every other hole par four, par five, we have to start using your drive too.
quotes.quote: We are going to implement a rule at some point. Every other hole par four, par five, we have to start using your drive too. You are driving 932 yards every time, okay? I tried to tell you that at the beginning.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James explains the new rule for the remaining holes
quotes.excerpt: For the next 12 holes, you get to decide for six holes and then six holes.
quotes.quote: For the next 12 holes, you get to decide for six holes and then six holes whose tee off the tee that you take. Obviously, Jason Creech right here, who has been hitting the ball 3,000 yards off the tee, they get to use six of his, and then after that they got to use six of Lynn's. But you get to decide whenever you want to use that. Same with me and Ramos.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James

quotes.speaker: LeBron James

quotes.quote: I got to take my licks early on in my career, my golf career. That is what is going to make the journey incredible, you know what I mean?
